subject.title: refactor(channels): separate status output from snapshot input

question: Should OpenClaw accept the proposed public plugin-SDK status split and its deprecated `ChannelAccountSnapshot` migration window, or keep the existing single public type until a narrower SDK contract is agreed?
rationale: The change is technically coherent but intentionally changes the public plugin API surface and establishes a future deprecation path; repository policy requires maintainer-visible acceptance for that permanent compatibility direction.

options.title: Accept the split with a defined migration window
options.body: Approve the Gateway-derived output type and permissive input type while keeping the legacy alias temporarily, with maintainers owning its documented removal point.

options.title: Narrow the public SDK surface
options.body: Keep the projection refactor but avoid exporting parallel public types until the plugin API direction is explicitly designed and documented.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Defer this broad contract consolidation if the compatibility and ownership cost outweighs the current drift reduction.

recommendation.title: Accept the split with a defined migration window
recommendation.body: Approve the Gateway-derived output type and permissive input type while keeping the legacy alias temporarily, with maintainers owning its documented removal point.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the same public status-redaction boundary and provides the strongest current-main routing signal.
